changed_path_mapping.source_edge: RUMSessionScope.viewScopes.didSet records the previous active view as inactive before assigning the next active view (RUMSessionScope.swift:42-50).
endReason's first transition deactivates the active view, and deinit deactivates it again idempotently (RUMSessionScope.swift:117-128 and deactivateActiveView near the end of the file).
Restoration constructs a fresh RUMViewScope and inserts its new ID as active (RUMSessionScope.swift:212-255).
ViewCache tracks inactiveSince, purges only inactive entries by TTL, and then enforces capacity (ViewCache.swift:19-27 and 53-135).

exp207_result.source_boundary: Independent E04 only; its eight lifecycle/container red cases and five preservation controls cover the changed cache/session paths.
exp207_result.native_limit: The native arm is injected WebView/controller writer JSON, so it supports delayed-container routing only; no host-lifetime claim is needed for E04.

exp212_result.source_boundary: Exact EXP207 unit/native controls were rerun on the composed source; the additional real-core lifetime control is separate evidence and does not alter E04's changed-path mapping.

preserved_original_review.hash_note: The correction artifact truncates the superseded hash by one character; this full hash is computed from the preserved original.

correction.removed_requirement: UIKit and SwiftUI host-removal tests with pending Resource completion are not required to qualify the E04 cache/session change.
correction.reason: ViewCache stores scalar view metadata only; E04 adds no UIKit/SwiftUI host reference, pending Resource ownership, or callback retention edge. Those are S2:P03/EXP213 obligations and must remain separately scoped.
correction.no_unproven_transfer_contract: No new transferred-Resource ownership assertion is proposed. Existing restoration evidence is limited to the implemented contract: a fresh RUMViewScope/cache ID is created from the prior active view's identity/path metadata and the old scope releases.

limits: ordinary UIKit or SwiftUI host destruction
pending Resource callback retention or host ownership
DisplayLinker/core teardown, covered separately by EXP211/EXP212
